responsibility: Provides the x86 AMX-COMPLEX intrinsic header for complex FP16 tile operations. It enables the amx-complex target feature when needed and defines macro interfaces for the complex matrix tile instructions tcmmimfp16ps and tcmmrlfp16ps, giving C/C++ code access to AMX complex tile multiply-accumulate functionality through GCC’s x86 intrinsic layer rather than through generic SIMD builtins.
